finding.name: UNIFIEDDB_UNKNOWN_FUTURE_SCHEMA_COULD_BE_SILENTLY_DOWNGRADED
mechanism: UnifiedDB is the canonical durable state authority, so unknown persistent schema semantics must fail closed.
Current main executed CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS and then unconditionally rewrote meta.schema_version to 6.
A database declaring a higher unknown schema version could therefore be relabeled as the local version without proving that its physical/logical schema was compatible.
The existing schema-2 migration regression was also stale: it still expected schema version 5 while current main writes 6.

contract: check existing schema metadata before executing the local SCHEMA bootstrap or rewriting schema_version
reject missing, invalid, non-positive, or newer-than-supported schema metadata when a meta table already exists
bind tests to CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION instead of a stale literal
prove that a rejected future schema remains labeled with its original future version and preserves a sentinel turn

bounded_execution_evidence.scope: byte-identical store.py mechanism only; not full checkout, not full pytest suite, not OCI/runtime acceptance
